name: Michael Dada
career_history: Site Selection & Colocation at Nebius, 8/2026 to present; Data Centre Consultant at Freelance, 11/2025 to 8/2026; Managing Director / General Manager at VIRTUS Data Centers Germany, 2024 to 10/2025; Academic teacher at IU University, 2023 to 2024; Director at CBRE, 2019 to 2023; Senior Consultant at CBRE, 2016 to 2016; Consultant - Associate Director at CBRE, 2013 to 2019; Trainee at CBRE, 2011 to 2011
education: Master Geography, Norwegian, Norges teknisk-naturvitenskapelige universitet, 2009
Master of Business Administration, University of Applied Science Biberach, University of Westminster, 2019
biography: As Managing Director for Virtus's German entity (Jan 2024 - July 2024), Michael oversaw two sites: 90 MVA in Berlin and 300 MVA in Wustermark. Responsibilities included building the team (7 people plus himself when he left), establishing operations, brand development, and cultivating relationships with public authorities. He managed office setup, project oversight (Steerco meetings, reporting), capital requests, marketing events, and recruitment for the new region. He engaged in strategic discussions, budgeting, and public relations, acting as the market face for Virtus in Germany. He possesses over 5 years of experience in entitlements and permitting processes, specifically within Germany. He reported to Neil Creswell (CEO of Virtus) before Creswell's departure, with the reporting structure changing under an interim CEO. He had one direct report (Office Manager) and dotted line reports including Project Managers, Power Construction, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations. Michael resigned from Virtus last month and is on garden leave until end of January 2025. Management changes occurred in March 2024, leading to the CEO's departure and an interim CEO taking over. His role was redefined due to pressure from HQ and investors on German projects, and his relationship with management deteriorated, leading to his resignation after approximately 1.5 years in the active role. He expressed frustration over the short tenure and having relocated his family from Dusseldorf to Berlin for the position. Michael's ideal role is in general management, development manager, or similar with strong real estate, investment, and advisory components, focusing on commercial and organizational management. He is looking for a title of Director and above, with people management being a plus. He seeks a minimum 150k EUR base salary and 40-50% bonus, with flexibility on stock options. He is Berlin-based for 2-3 years and willing to travel 20-40%. He has past experience with CBRE (2012-2023) and Virtus data centers (Jan 2024 - July/Aug 2024). He is currently interviewing with Edge Connects (Site Manager) and Vantage (Head of Development, Germany). He is interested in the data industry, real estate consulting, corporate real estate, and data centers. He is seeking a new challenging and exciting role with growth potential where he can add value, applying his extensive experience in data center development, German market build-out, and public relations. He is currently based in Berlin, Germany, and short-term relocation is not an option for the next two to three years due to family settlement. He may consider long-term relocation in two to three years, potentially to another country. He is open to travel (20-40%).

assessment.note: Ward Search's own judgement, not a researched fact.
